D01_December_focus.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.period,i.label FROM price_observation o JOIN publication p USING(publication_id) JOIN item i USING(item_id) JOIN geography g USING(geography_id) WHERE p.period='2025-12' AND i.label=? ORDER BY p.period,i.label

D02_December_with_national.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.period,i.label FROM price_observation o JOIN publication p USING(publication_id) JOIN item i USING(item_id) JOIN geography g USING(geography_id) WHERE p.period='2025-12' AND g.level='national' ORDER BY p.period,i.label

D03_without_national.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.period,i.label FROM price_observation o JOIN publication p USING(publication_id) JOIN item i USING(item_id) JOIN geography g USING(geography_id) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_observation x JOIN geography gx USING(geography_id) WHERE x.publication_id=o.publication_id AND x.item_id=o.item_id AND gx.level='national') ORDER BY p.period,i.label

D04_without_zones.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.period,i.label FROM price_observation o JOIN publication p USING(publication_id) JOIN item i USING(item_id) JOIN geography g USING(geography_id) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_observation x JOIN geography gx USING(geography_id) WHERE x.publication_id=o.publication_id AND x.item_id=o.item_id AND gx.level='zone') ORDER BY p.period,i.label

D05_national_at_least_100000_kobo.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.period,i.label FROM price_observation o JOIN publication p USING(publication_id) JOIN item i USING(item_id) JOIN geography g USING(geography_id) WHERE g.name='Nigeria' AND o.price_kobo>=100000 ORDER BY p.period,i.label
